authority: OWNER-BATTERY-CHAMPIONSHIP-03 §1; the owner, 2026-10-12 (Test Lead session): "the grain is the Test Engineer's measured screening standard error, rounded up to the nearest 0.5% (minimum 0.5%)"
rounding: each entry: its measured SE rounded UP to a 0.005 step, floor 0.005
lookup: PLT-08 uses the ONE entry whose `match` equals the deployment: its rule name, the published score section and, when the rule has a registered score term, that term's candidate and registry_sha256; where an entry gives `rule_digest`, the deployment's rule digest must equal it too. No match, or more than one: SEALED_UNTIL_GRAIN (fail closed).
new_rule: a newly adopted rule or score candidate (e.g. a v9 or v10 pick) gets its own measured entry, as a new file version, before it goes live; until then the lookup refuses
display_rule: displayed = (1 + grain)^k, k an integer, rounded toward the WORSE side by the entry's sense so the display never overstates: lower_is_better -> k = ceil(ln(score) / ln(1 + grain)); higher_is_better -> k = floor(ln(score) / ln(1 + grain))
update_rule: a coldkey's displayed value changes only when a submission's grid value is at least one grid step better than the coldkey's displayed best (lower_is_better: k_new <= k_best - 1; higher_is_better: k_new >= k_best + 1); otherwise 'no improvement beyond the grain'
convention: a display convention under the owner's grain decision (OWNER-BATTERY-CHAMPIONSHIP-04 section 3), not a new threshold

entries.score: the pooled mean per-case error on the pooled screening cases

entries.rule_digest_note: not given: the deployed v3 rule carries the deployment's own score term, whose bytes are not in the repository (the template digest covers its REGISTERED_BY_DEPLOYMENT placeholder); the operator may add the deployed digest in a later version
entries.sense_source: carbon/battery/exam.py rule v3-bank-sched: the registered candidate's score, higher is better (OWNER-BATTERY-SCORE-CANDIDATE-01)
entries.score: the registered score a^0.5 q^0.5 on the pooled screening cases and the active windows' design questions
entries.evidence_strength: thin: 10 public members with EV4 development decisions, 9 public scenarios; member spread P10-P90 1.743615-11.615765 %. Remeasure on PUBLIC-DEV-DECISIONS-01's public run, and from scored submissions after the cutover; each is a new file version
